gates.reason: Checked enterprise authentication/capability gating, upload and LLM surface boundaries, URL/DOM handling, and secret-bearing state flows; no exploitable client-side bypass, injection, or unauthorized egress was established.
Checked dataset replacement/deduplication, recommendation-analysis generation binding, evidence validation, and stale snapshot retirement; claims remain tied to validated current evidence.

Checked the large application hot path for repeated derivations, eager bundle loading, upload blocking, and state churn; expensive views/helpers are lazy, major derivations memoized, parsing off-thread, and result application scheduled.

Checked the dangerouslySetInnerHTML sink adversarially against the directly related baseline shell renderer; shell markup is fixed and dynamic KPI values are integer-normalized, so no attacker-controlled HTML path was established.
This hydration transition component performs no detector, parser, recommendation, provenance, or arithmetic claim calculation.
The gate performs one bounded paint transition with both rAF and timeout handles cleaned up; no recurring work or material bundle surface was found.

Checked the SPA/server mount boundary, boot-envelope parsing, shell capture, and hydration path; parsed boot data is passed as React data and captured shell HTML originates from the injection-safe baseline shell renderer.
The entry point selects hydration versus fresh mount and does not produce recommendation claims or detector/calculation output.
The entry point preserves the server-painted shell and avoids a destructive duplicate mount; imports and branching add no repeated hot-path work.
This static stylesheet contains only scoped layout rules and keyframes, with no external resource, secret, executable configuration, or user-controlled interpolation.
The stylesheet defines no detector, parser, calculation, evidence, or recommendation content.
The global stylesheet is small (928 bytes), contains one simple animation and narrowly scoped rules, and exposes no costly selector or asset-loading pattern.
This test-only state factory performs no authentication, filesystem, network/LLM egress, DOM injection, command execution, or secret handling.

The reproducible ready-state helper assembles one canonical input and derives both recommendations and coverage through the real recommendation engine; explicit-state helpers preserve caller-supplied results without fabricating evidence.
The module is test-only and excluded from application entry points and production bundles, so its engine invocation is not a shipped hot path.
